name: @natlang/pi
description: pi's durable coding agent harness, ported to natlang: pi-durable (vendored) hosts conversations and durable tasks; the harness's behaviour — each generation, tool and compaction phase, context and prompt planning, the tool-call policy, admission and the scheduler's policy — is natural-language functions run by the executor, and pi's coding tools and subagent are natural-language functions too. The agent is a provider model reached through pi-ai.

pi.description: natlang run applications/pi -- [--agent-endpoint URL --agent-model ID] [--pure] TASK... | eval [NAME...]
